subject: lag by date (not the order of the dates)?

messages.author: 2b27719db7267c87
messages.subject: lag by date (not the order of the dates)?
parts:
Is there a way to retrieve values from previous dates that recognizes when a previous date does not exist?  

Here is an example of what I am trying to do.  I have a data frame containing amounts of sleep obtained on several dates.

require(dplyr)

require(lubridate)

nights <- 

  data.frame(date=ymd("2014-06-01", "2014-06-02", "2014-06-04", 

                      "2014-06-05", "2014-06-06"),

             sleep=c(7.3, 6.9, 8.1, 7.5, 7.8))

nights


#        date sleep

#1 2014-06-01   7.3

#2 2014-06-02   6.9

#3 2014-06-04   8.1

#4 2014-06-05   7.5

#5 2014-06-06   7.8


I would like to add a column containing, for each observation, the amount of sleep obtained on the previous date.  If the previous date is not in the data frame, I would like it to return NA.  I tried the following approach, but it does not do what I am looking for: the value in row 3 of the new column should be NA, since the previous date was not recorded.

nights %>%

  mutate(prior.sleep=lag(sleep, order_by=date))


#        date sleep prior.sleep

#1 2014-06-01   7.3          NA

#2 2014-06-02   6.9         7.3

#3 2014-06-04   8.1         6.9

#4 2014-06-05   7.5         8.1

#5 2014-06-06   7.8         7.5

Is there a way to lag by date, rather than the order of the dates, using dplyr?  Thanks very much for any help.

Bonnie

messages.author: b756a7daa2c2aa6d
messages.subject: Re: lag by date (not the order of the dates)?
parts:
Hi Bonnie,

In this case, I think you need to make your implicit missing values
explicit. The easiest way to do that is usually with a join:

require(dplyr)
require(lubridate)

nights <- data.frame(
date = as.Date(ymd("2014-06-01")) + c(0, 1, 3, 4, 5),
sleep = c(7.3, 6.9, 8.1, 7.5, 7.8)
)

date_range <- range(nights$date)
all_nights <- data.frame(date = seq(date_range[1], date_range[2], "day"))

all_nights %>%
left_join(nights)

Hadley

> mutate(nights, prior.sleep = lag(sleep) * ((c(NA, diff(date)) == 1) | NA))

3 2014-06-04   8.1          NA
